en.headline: Health authorities confirm imported mpox case
en.dek: A 40-year-old man is in stable condition at Princess Margaret Hospital after high-risk contact while outside Hong Kong, the Centre for Health Protection said.
body: The Centre for Health Protection reported an imported mpox case on Wednesday involving a 40-year-old man who is in stable condition. The centre said he had high-risk sexual contact while outside Hong Kong during the incubation period.

The patient developed a rash in several places from 20 September, had a fever the day before last, and sought care at a Social Hygiene Clinic on Tuesday. He was transferred to Princess Margaret Hospital for isolation. Laboratory tests on clinical samples confirmed mpox virus.

The centre said cases have risen since August. As of Wednesday, Hong Kong had recorded 29 cases this year — 22 local and seven imported — of which 20 have been identified since August. Recent patients all reported high-risk sexual activity in the incubation period, including contact with unknown male partners or multiple partners and sex without condoms. About two-fifths were living with HIV, and most had not received mpox vaccination.

Genetic analysis found matching sequences in some cases, which the centre said suggested a common source as well as more than one transmission chain among men who have sex with men. The case will be notified to the World Health Organization.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心公布一宗輸入猴痘個案
zh.dek: 一名40歲男子潛伏期在外地有高風險性接觸，現於瑪嘉烈醫院隔離，情況穩定。
body: 衞生防護中心星期三公布一宗輸入猴痘個案，患者為40歲男子，目前情況穩定。中心表示，他於潛伏期內曾在離港期間有高風險性接觸。
病人自本月20日起身體多處出現皮疹，前日發燙，昨日到衞生署社會衞生科診所求診，其後入住瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療。臨床樣本化驗對猴痘病毒呈陽性。
中心指，今年8月起本港個案上升。截至今日本年累計29宗，包括22宗本地及7宗輸入，其中20宗為8月以來新增。近期20宗患者均報稱潛伏期內有高風險性行為，包括與陌生男士或多名伴侶發生性行為，以及沒有使用安全套；約四成同時為愛滋病病毒感染者，大部分未曾接種猴痘疫苗。
公共衞生化驗服務處基因分析發現部分個案序列相同，中心相信可能有共同感染源頭，並在男男性接觸者群體中存在不同傳播鏈。中心正進行流行病學調查，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
